name: Avalanche Wraith
desc: Its weakness shifts each turn; match the medal type for bonus damage.
backstory: Born from the restless spirits of forgotten mountaineers and the melting glaciers of the Rockies, the Avalanche Wraith embodies the crushing weight of unmet expectations. It preys on the athletes' fears of failure, its chilling presence threatening to bury the Olympic dream beneath an insurmountable cascade of doubt.
